body.statement: The map \(\operatorname{OR}:(0,1)^2\to(0,\infty)\) has no path-independent continuous extension at \((0,0)\) or \((1,1)\), so \(\theta_{a,x}\) is used only on the strictly positive chart \(\mathcal M^{\circ}\).  For each \(r\in(0,1)\) and finite \(\theta>0\), \(\kappa(r,w,\theta)\), \(q_{a,x}(w_0,w_1;\theta)\), and the endpoint objectives \(H_x^-\) and \(H_x^+\) extend continuously in \((w_0,w_1)\) to all of the compact region \(D_{A,x}\), including the constant-\(U\) corners.
body.justification: This separates the interior odds-ratio chart from the compact probability-scale optimization that attains boundary endpoints.
body.gap: Fixed-parameter binary-confounder calculations do not distinguish the odds-ratio chart from its well-defined probability-scale boundary objectives.
body.consumer: The sharpness theorem and exact verifier can include null latent cells without assigning an ill-defined boundary odds ratio.
